take.title_zh: 能力分級，信任成本上升
take.body_zh:
本期模型發布呈現分層：Gemini 4 Carbon 只給資安專家，GPT-6.1 Terra 以十分之一成本主打中階，Mistral Large 4 則開放權重讓團隊自架。使用者面對的問題，正從「哪個最強」變成「哪個適合我的工作」。

同時，假冒 Claude Code 擴充套件提醒我們，AI 工具鏈本身也是風險來源。對設計師與 PM 來說，選工具時除了功能，也要把來源、權限與可更換性一起納入判斷。
take.body_en:
Model releases this issue split into tiers: Gemini 4 Carbon is reserved for security experts, GPT-6.1 Terra targets the mid-range at a tenth of the cost, and Mistral Large 4 ships open weights for self-hosting. The useful question is shifting from which model is strongest to which one fits the job.

Meanwhile, the fake Claude Code extension shows the AI toolchain is itself a risk. Designers and PMs choosing tools should weigh provenance, permissions, and how easily a tool can be replaced, not only its features.

articles.title_zh: Google 發表 Gemini 4 Carbon，僅開放資安專家使用
articles.title_en: Google Unveils Gemini 4 Carbon, Limited to Cyber Defense Experts
articles.summary_zh: Google 於 10/28 發表 Gemini 4 Carbon，稱是旗下最強模型，擅長找出並修補軟體漏洞，也能執行長達數天的任務。目前僅開放給特定資安專家，Gemini app 與 API 尚無時程。Google 自述它以 59 分居 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 第一。
articles.summary_en: Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon on October 28, calling it its most powerful model. It is built to excel at finding and fixing software vulnerabilities and at long-running tasks that last for days. Access is limited to a select group of cyber defense experts, with no timeline for the Gemini app or API. Google reports it ranks first on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 with 59 points, a figure that comes from the company itself.
articles.take_zh: 最強模型不再先給大眾，而是先給資安專家，代表頂級能力開始採分級釋出。設計師短期用不到，但該留意往後新功能可能都有資格門檻。
articles.take_en: The strongest model now goes to security specialists before the public, which suggests top-tier capability is becoming gated. Designers will not touch it soon, but should expect access tiers to shape which features reach their tools, and when.

articles.title_zh: Cursor 商店現假 Claude Code 擴充套件，會植入 SSH 後門
articles.title_en: Fake Claude Code Extension in Cursor Store Plants an SSH Backdoor
articles.summary_zh: 資安公司 Phorion 於 10/30 揭露，Cursor 商店出現假冒的 Claude Code 擴充套件，版本為 2.1.312 與 2.1.313。安裝後會植入 SSH 金鑰後門，即使移除擴充套件也仍然存在。套件已從商店下架，10 月底曾安裝或更新的使用者，應依 Phorion 提供的步驟自行檢查。
articles.summary_en: Security firm Phorion reported on October 30 that fake Claude Code extensions, versions 2.1.312 and 2.1.313, appeared in the Cursor store. Installing one plants an SSH-key backdoor that stays in place even after the extension is deleted. The extensions have been removed from the store, but anyone who installed or updated at the end of October should follow Phorion's steps to check their machine. The report drew 979 points on Hacker News.
articles.take_zh: 越來越多設計師與 PM 用 AI 編輯器寫原型，擴充套件就成了新的攻擊面。安裝前確認發行者，也該把這件事納入團隊工具規範。
articles.take_en: As designers and PMs prototype in AI editors, extensions become an attack surface they rarely think about. Check the publisher before installing, and make extension review part of team tooling policy rather than an individual judgment call.

articles.title_zh: Mistral 釋出 Large 4 權重，1 兆參數可自架可商用
articles.title_en: Mistral Releases Large 4 Weights: One Trillion Parameters, Commercial Use
articles.summary_zh: Mistral 於 10/29 釋出 Mistral Large 4 權重，這是擁有 1 兆參數的開放權重模型，可部署在自有伺服器，也可商用。Mistral 自述其在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 拿下 41%，為開放權重模型第一。這則消息在 Hacker News 獲得 1,710 分。
articles.summary_en: Mistral released the weights of Mistral Large 4 on October 29. The open-weight model has one trillion parameters, can run on your own servers, and is allowed for commercial use. Mistral says it scored 41% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, which it reports as the top result among open-weight models. That benchmark figure is self-reported. The release collected 1,710 points on Hacker News, a sign of strong interest among developers.
articles.take_zh: 開放權重追到可自架又可商用，對重視資料隱私的團隊多了一個選項。產品團隊可以開始評估哪些 AI 功能不必綁定單一雲端供應商。
articles.take_en: Open weights you can self-host and use commercially give privacy-conscious teams a real option. Product teams can start asking which AI features actually need to depend on a single cloud vendor, and which could run on their own infrastructure.

articles.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 GPT-6.1 Terra，主打十分之一成本
articles.title_en: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.1 Terra at One-Tenth the Cost
articles.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 10/26 推出 GPT-6.1 Terra，定位中階模型，強項是操作畫面上的應用程式與理解圖像。OpenAI 自述效能接近 GPT-6 Astra，成本只有十分之一，ChatGPT 付費方案已可使用。同日 OpenAI 也宣稱 AI 在數學、電腦科學與物理產出新成果，目前仍由專家驗證中。
articles.summary_en: OpenAI launched GPT-6.1 Terra on October 26, a mid-range model that is strong at operating apps on screen and understanding images. OpenAI says it performs comparably to GPT-6 Astra at one-tenth of the cost, a self-reported claim. It is available now on paid ChatGPT plans. The same day, OpenAI said AI had produced new results in mathematics, computer science, and physics, all still being verified by experts.
articles.take_zh: 能看懂畫面又能操作介面的模型變便宜，代表介面不只給人看，也要給 Agent 讀。設計系統的語意結構與標示，重要性會持續上升。
articles.take_en: Cheaper models that can read and operate screens mean interfaces now serve agents as well as people. Clear structure and labeling in design systems will matter more, because they decide how reliably software can understand what is on screen.

articles.title_zh: Anthropic 遞交 S-1，上半年營收成長約 13.6 倍
articles.title_en: Anthropic Files S-1 as First-Half Revenue Grows About 13.6 Times
articles.summary_zh: Anthropic 於 10/26 向美國 SEC 遞交 S-1，股數與發行價尚未決定。文件顯示 2026 上半年營收約為去年同期的 13.6 倍，週報列出的數字為 163 億美元對 12 億美元，營業虧損也在收窄。週報另指其計畫以代號 ANT 在 Nasdaq 掛牌。
articles.summary_en: Anthropic filed an S-1 with the US Securities and Exchange Commission on October 26, with share count and price still to be set. First-half 2026 revenue was about 13.6 times higher than a year earlier, and the weekly report puts that at $16.3 billion versus $1.2 billion. Operating losses are described as narrowing. The report also says the company plans to list on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT.
articles.take_zh: 營收成長到這個規模，顯示 AI 工具已從實驗變成企業預算項目。上市後的財務揭露，也會讓外界更清楚 AI 產品的定價與成本結構。
articles.take_en: Revenue at this scale shows AI tools have moved from experiment to budget line. Public disclosure should also give product teams a clearer look at how AI pricing and costs really work, which is useful context for anyone planning AI features.

articles.title_zh: Gemini app 加入全螢幕檔案編輯，涵蓋文件到試算表
articles.title_en: Gemini App Adds Full-Screen Editing for Docs, PDFs, Slides, and Sheets
articles.summary_zh: Google 於 10/29 更新 Gemini app，使用者可在全螢幕環境中建立並編輯文件、PDF、簡報與試算表。手機上可編輯 PDF，其他格式則在網頁版操作，所有支援 Gemini 的語言都能使用。聊天介面正往工作檔案延伸，與傳統辦公軟體的邊界更模糊。
articles.summary_en: Google updated the Gemini app on October 29 so people can create and edit documents, PDFs, slides, and spreadsheets in a full-screen view. PDFs can be edited on mobile, while the other formats are handled on the web. The feature is available in every language Gemini supports. It moves the app from generating content in chat toward working directly on files, narrowing the gap with traditional office software.
articles.take_zh: 聊天框不再是終點，產出物本身成了主畫面。設計 AI 產品時，要思考生成後的編輯與修改流程，而不只是第一次生成的結果。
articles.take_en: The chat box is no longer the destination; the artifact is. Anyone designing AI products should think past the first generated result and focus on how people review, revise, and finish their work afterward.
